title: Request
description:
Request envelope (`nurt-request/1`).

Exactly one of `program`, `ast`, `cursor` and `accept` is present;
`variant` is allowed only with `program`. [`Request::input`] returns the
input and enforces the rule.

program.description:
Program text in any notation variant; the instance parses and
corrects it.

variant.description:
Notation variant of `program`. Default: the configured variant, with
the other variants accepted when tolerant parsing is enabled.

cursor.description:
Cursor of a further page of an earlier result; reading a page never
runs a changing program again.

accept.description:
Identifier of a candidate from an earlier `E_AMBIGUOUS` error, for
example `c1`.

params.description:
Values of the parameters of a script that starts with `params { … }`,
by parameter name. A value is typed JSON, or text that is read by the
declared type, as the command line passes it. Checked against the
declaration before any effect.

SyntaxVariant.description: Notation variant of the text form of a program.

AstDocument.description: Root of a surface tree document.

Program.description: A program: statements executed in order.

statements.description: Statements in source order; at least one.

oneOf.description: Loop with a condition after the body, `repeat until: … { … }`.
Loop with a condition before the body, `while … { … }`.
Starts the next iteration of the innermost loop.

Arg.description: An argument of a stage: positional (`20`) or named (`glob: "**/*.go"`).

name.description: Parameter name of a named argument; absent for a positional argument.

span.description: Source range; covers the name and the value of a named argument.

Expr.description:
An expression node.

The parser produces `text` for every quoted string, including paths,
globs, instants and keys, and `ident` for every bare identifier; the
binder types them by their place in the command signature. The `key` node
is a structured alternative to a key written as text, accepted from
producers that build trees directly.

oneOf.description: Text, `"abc"` or `r"abc"`; the value after escape processing.
Bare identifier: an enumeration value or a field name (`desc`, `size`).

v.description: Pattern; `\/` of the written form is stored as `/`.

flags.description: Flags from `imsx` in this order, possibly empty.

oneOf.description: Structured key in a document, an alternative to a key written as text.
Spread of a list into the enclosing list, `...@recent.path`.

of.description:
Expression whose field is read; absent for a field of the current
record.

fields.description: Field path after the name; omitted when empty.

anyOf.description: List index, `0`; a negative index counts from the end.

oneOf.description: `*`: every member or element of one level.
`**`: every member or element at any depth.
`+`: a new element appended at the end of a list.

span.description: Source range, from the key to the end of the value.

oneOf.description: Membership in a list or range, `in`.

name.description:
Command name as written after correction: identifiers joined by `.`
(`find`, `git.status`).

Pipeline.description: A pipeline: a head followed by stages joined with `|>`.

head.description: First element: a stage or a reference to a named result.

stages.description: Stages after the head, in order; possibly empty.

name.description: Name of the result, `[a-z][a-z0-9_]*`; referenced as `@name`.

value.description: Pipeline whose result is bound to the name.

Branch.description:
A branch of a `when`: a condition and the block that runs when it is the
first condition that holds.

cond.description: Condition of the branch; a `bool` expression.

body.description: Statements of the branch, at least one.

span.description: Source range, from the keyword to the closing brace.

When.description: Conditional: `when c { … } otherwise when d { … } otherwise { … }`.

branches.description: The `when` branch followed by every `otherwise when` branch.

otherwise.description: The `otherwise` block; absent when the construct has none.

Each.description: Loop over the records of an expression: `each (find …) as f { … }`.

source.description: Expression whose records the loop visits, in input order.

name.description: Name bound to the record of the iteration; referenced as `@name`.

Repeat.description:
Loop that tests its condition after each run of the body:
`repeat until: c every: 5s limit: 2m { … }`.

While.description:
Loop that tests its condition before each run of the body:
`while c limit: 20 { … }`.

body.description: Steps in order, at least one.

Param.description: Declaration of a typed parameter of a function or of a script.

default.description: Default value; absent for a required parameter.

Define.description: Definition of a function: `define name(a: path, b: int = 7) { … }`.

body.description: Statements of the body, at least one.

Params.description: Parameters of a `.nurt` file: `params { dir: path  days: int = 30 }`.

RequestOptions.description:
Call options shared by every command.

An absent option takes its value from the configuration, and without a
configured value from the built-in default returned by the accessor
methods. Options given in the call override the configuration.

preview.description: Only compute targets and effect; change nothing. Default `false`.

base.description:
Absolute directory against which relative paths are resolved; it is
not a current directory.

limit.description:
Number of records or changes per page, from 1 to [`MAX_LIMIT`].
Default [`DEFAULT_LIMIT`].

fields.description: Fields of the result to keep, like a final `select`.

format.description: Format of the rendered result. Default `text`.

verbosity.description: Level of detail of the report. Default `normal`.

max_chars.description:
Largest number of characters of a single text field of the result;
`0` means no limit. Shortened fields are marked `truncated: true`.

save_to.description:
Absolute path of a file that receives the full result (UTF-8) instead
of the response; the report then gives `result_file`.

timeout.description:
Time limit of the whole program, for example `120s` or `1h30m`.
Default [`DEFAULT_TIMEOUT`].

session.description: Session identifier recorded in the journal.

language.description: Language of messages and help. Default `en`.

script.description:
Script mode: several pipelines, each its own operation. Default
`false`.

privilege.description:
Rights of the operation. Default `account`, or the configuration key
`privilege.default`.

as_user.description:
Name of another account that runs the operation (Linux and macOS);
implies elevation for the switch.

oneOf.description: The report as JSON only; nothing is rendered.
One record per line, without headings.

Verbosity.description: Level of detail of the effect report.

oneOf.description:
Status, operation number, targets, summary, notable and irreversible
effects; no list of changes and no differences.

Summary, changes up to the page limit, a sample of differences and the
bulk summary of bulk operations.

All changes and differences, paged, and the durations of the
processing steps.

DiffMode.description: Form of differences in the report of a change.

oneOf.description: Numbers of added and removed lines only.

Language.description:
Language of messages, help and hints; codes, fields and keywords are
always English.

Privilege.description: Rights with which an operation runs (call option `privilege`).

oneOf.description: The rights of the account that runs Nurt.

The rights of the administrator: `root` on Linux and macOS,
`LocalSystem` on Windows.

Runs with `account`; a stage that fails with `E_PERMISSION` or
`E_PRIVILEGE` is repeated once with `elevated` before any change is
kept.
